references.cloneScope: Clone the complete home-page geometry, section sequence, relative heights, image cropping logic, restrained type placement, navigation, native scrolling, and desktop-to-mobile transformation before any DaSelva swap.

strategyAllocations.allocationReason: Cecilie Bahnsen is the highest-scoring complete single-page candidate and can carry the target's seven movements without donors or category-based normalization.
strategyAllocations.baselineExitCondition: Matched 1440x1000 and 390x844 baselines meet the frozen geometry, scroll-length, responsive, and motion tolerances before target assets enter.

strategyAllocations.strategyName: primary chassis clone with bounded donor transplants

references.cloneScope: Clone Playfight as the complete page: global navigation, floating-media opening field, white-space rhythm, long-form section order, responsive model, and scroll authority.
Clone only the rounded overlapping media constellation with its 01/02/03 state navigation as one bounded scene. It does not own the global page, type, color, or scroll system.
Clone only the oversized identity-to-information composition and asymmetric grid as one bounded editorial scene. It does not supply global typography, navigation, palette, or section rhythm.

documentedPrimaryGaps: Playfight lacks one compact, stateful hero-to-signature-dish media constellation.
Playfight lacks one typographically forceful target-origin information scene that remains disciplined without animation.
strategyAllocations.ownershipRule: Playfight owns the global spine. Each donor owns exactly one named scene, is cloned independently, and may enter only after the primary baseline passes.
strategyAllocations.baselineExitCondition: The Playfight full-page baseline and both isolated donor-scene baselines pass their matched desktop/mobile checks before any transplant or target swap.

strategyAllocations.strategyName: scene-clone synthesis with a static taste stop

references.cloneScope: Clone the dark floating-media opening and its pinned narrative cadence as W's first scene baseline.
Clone the full-bleed moving-image plane, quiet micro-navigation, and restrained overlay type as the Banda scene baseline.
Clone the perspective typographic chamber and virtual state transition as W's high-risk transition scene baseline.

strategyAllocations.compatibilityHypothesis: After target-owned swaps, the three scenes can share one static grammar: deep forest-green fields, terracotta emphasis, off-white type, large image planes, sparse navigation, and one deliberately theatrical transition. Category played no part in this hypothesis.
strategyAllocations.staticTasteRisk: The Red's perspective chamber can overpower the quieter Ponder and Bureau Rouge scenes; W0 must prove hierarchy and restraint without motion.
strategyAllocations.mandatoryStop: After independent scene baselines and target swaps, produce only motion-free desktop and mobile W0 boards. No W motion may begin without explicit human approval of every frozen taste dimension.
